# launchd - LM Studio

[API index](index.md) | [Definition schema](schema.md)

| Field | Value |
| --- | --- |
| ID | `launchd.lm-studio` |
| Source | `09_launchd/lm_studio.yaml` |
| Tags | launchd, ai |

Runs the LM Studio CLI server bound to 127.0.0.1:1234. The `lms server
start` command exits cleanly once the daemon is up, so this job overrides
`launchd.base`'s `keep_alive: true` to restart only on crashes.
